verdict.rationale: Monday.com's docs describe built-in AI agents that can be @mentioned, assigned items, and messaged directly like teammates to kick off real work (monday-docs-11, monday-docs-19), with agents buildable from natural-language workflow descriptions (monday-docs-13, monday-docs-14) and manageable from an admin dashboard (monday-docs-10). This directly matches delegating tasks to a built-in AI assistant. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the AI assistant's real-world performance (community evidence available is generic pre-AI-era complaints about UI/performance, not about the AI assistant feature itself).
